# Recreation Prompt

Recreate a mobile portrait browser game called Felony Freeway: Pocket City Mischief. Preserve the mechanics of a canvas free-roam action-survival game: joystick/keyboard movement in a bounded world, collectible equipment pickup, a forward attack/ram cone, pursuing enemies, contact HP damage, score for defeated pursuers, random drops, persistent 60-item collection index, menu/index/game-over/restart states. Present it as Grand Theft Auto open-city action. A Grand Theft Auto open-city action game with urban sandbox freedom, crime chaos, vehicle chases, satire, police pursuit, street-level ambition, dark humor, and open-world systemic mischief with mobile-first controls, touch-friendly interactions, responsive readability, optimized on game start for portrait UI format, and the best-adapted mobile UX version targeting portrait aspect ratios in the 4:7 to 9:16 range. Use a procedural neon city, a getaway car focal actor, police cruiser hazards, street gear collectibles, street-rep score, heat-shield HP, darkly comic copy, and touch-friendly portrait controls.
blueprint_markdown:
# Blueprint

## Current implemented game identity
- genre: Mobile portrait canvas free-roam action-survival with collectible equipment and melee-style attack arcs.
- objective: Move around a large world, pick up randomly spawned tools, build persistent collection progress, defeat chasing enemies for score, and survive with three hit points.
- input model: Touch joystick for directional movement, two touch buttons for pickup and attack, plus keyboard arrows/WASD, E/K pickup, and Space/J attack.
- core loop: Start game, spawn player at world center, spawn collectibles and pursuers, roam freely, collect nearby equipment, attack pursuers in a forward cone, earn score from defeated pursuers, continue until contact damage removes all HP.
- fail/friction state: Contact with pursuers removes one HP with invulnerability; at zero HP the game enters a game-over screen with final score and restart/menu actions.

## Protected mechanics
- Large bounded free-roam world, camera follow, and portrait-first canvas rendering.
- Same joystick/buttons/keyboard input semantics.
- Same spawn caps, spawn timing, enemy chase behavior, collision-contact damage, three-HP fail state, attack cone, weapon damage/reach/cooldown/knockback, score on enemy defeat, random pickup drops, and persistent 60-item collection index.
- Same state flow: menu, collection index, active play, game over, restart.

## Remixed target
Felony Freeway: Pocket City Mischief reframes the grove knight loop as a satirical open-city chase sandbox. The player is a bright getaway car roaming a neon district, collectibles are dubious street gear, enemies are police cruisers, HP is heat shields, score is street rep, and game over is getting busted. Mechanics remain truthful while background, focal silhouettes, HUD language, feedback, media tone, and mobile controls are rebuilt for Grand Theft Auto open-city action. A Grand Theft Auto open-city action game with urban sandbox freedom, crime chaos, vehicle chases, satire, police pursuit, street-level ambition, dark humor, and open-world systemic mischief with mobile-first controls, touch-friendly interactions, responsive readability, optimized on game start for portrait UI format, and the best-adapted mobile UX version targeting portrait aspect ratios in the 4:7 to 9:16 range.
